newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Lehman announces senior management changes in Asia.
newsitem.headline: Lehman announces senior management changes in Asia.

text.p: Lehman Brothers said on Thursday it has made a series of management changes in Asia, including the appointment of Jarett Wait as chief executive of its Tokyo office and head of Asian capital markets.

In a statement, the investment bank said Wait will be responsible for strategic development and expansion of the debt and equity sales, trading and research businesses in Asia. He is now general manager of Lehman's Hong Kong operations and head of Asian equities.
Lehman also said Alan Marantz would take over as head of fixed income operations in Asia replacing Michael Gelband, who will move to New York to run the global fixed income derivatives business.
Mark DeGennaro will replace Marantz as head of global foreign exchange, it said.
Lehman also said Seck Wai Kwong, general manager in Singapore, would take on the additional position as head of fixed income sales and research for non-Japan Asia.
